task_title: Durable fix: prevent ci-owner lock deadlock (reaper lane + 422 crash fix + liveness TTL)

plan_review.notes: 3 blocking concerns raised: (1) double-dispatch: reaper PRs not excluded from normal dispatch set - fixed by tracking reaperDispatchedSet and filtering prNumbers; (2) train-mode partial hydration: train hydration stops early at targetDispatchable, so reaper would miss some stale PRs - fixed by unifying hydration to cover both train-partial and non-train paths; (3) unreadable state skipped: PRs with recoveryStateUnreadable=true could hold locks indefinitely - fixed by including them in identifyReapablePrs. Plan_divergence=minor (no re-architecture, 3 detail fixes).
